name: Lightweight high-performance remote desktop for Apple devices

mentions.name: Lightweight high-performance remote desktop for Apple devices
mentions.description: A lightweight, high-performance remote desktop that connects easy-to-carry Apple devices (MacBook Air/Neo or iPad) to a Mac mini.
mentions.problem: Existing remote desktop tools the author uses, such as Splashtop for WFH and Apple VNC for work servers, are slow.
